notes:
1. Removed Duplicate + Signs: Cleaned all action buttons across Returns, Purchases, Stock, Parties, and Accounts to display standard single + icons without duplicate label text.
2. Ultra-Minimal Main Layout: Eliminated bulky stacked cards and compressed headers into streamlined single-row executive bars, expanding table viewports by over 70% on standard laptop displays.
3. Dedicated Deep Subpages: Full-screen detailed subpages with back navigation for Credit/Debit Notes, Purchase Orders, Supplier Profiles, and Product Master details.
4. Universal List Limit Filter (10 | 20 | 50 | 100): Integrated row selector dropdowns and pagination controls (Prev/Next, Page X of Y) across Returns, Purchases, Suppliers, GRN Receipts, Stock Inventory, Customers, and Day Book / Vouchers.
5. Asset & Logo Resilience: Enhanced logo fallbacks with direct image asset bundling and graceful SVG error handling.
